events.title: Demo v2 is here: you can now play all the way to Stage 200!
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm Juanmao. Thank you to everyone who has tried the demo these past few days! Demo v2 is now available. I've added quite a few things to our little agency, so here's a look at what's changed. From 60 stages to 200 The first demo ended at Stage 60. Now you can take your team further and meet more heroes along the way. There are 62 heroes available to obtain in this version. events.title: October 8 Update | Straight Into the First Fight
events.summary: New players now go straight into Stage 1. The prologue becomes in-battle subtitles, and naming comes later. This part is still under construction, so it is not the finished version yet. Defeat guidance has changed too: advancement is folded into the upgrade step, and each step appears at most once per defeat. events.title: October 5 Update | Sorting Out Who Gives Shields
events.summary: This time I sorted out the support roles. Shields now come from the appropriate classes, and I went through the physical and magical damage paths too. Shield-related equipment is still useful, so your collection has not gone to waste. A few awkward display issues are fixed as well: percentage bonuses no longer appear twice. The formation screen labels allied positions, and aura descriptions tell you which team and how many rows they affect. Less guesswork. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46216320/82ff2f111ee

events.title: October 3 Update | Check the Loot Before You Idle
events.summary: First up: idling. When choosing a chapter, you can now preview its materials, sets, and legendary drops. Quantities increase with campaign progress. Targeted commissions also have badges for “already owned” and “not dropped here,” so you know what you are farming for. Then there are the click-savers: Academy research unlocks automatic Market trades for base materials and purchases of the day’s recruitment tickets. Free research rushes are used automatically. events.title: October 2 Update | A New Look for the Academy
events.summary: The Academy got most of the attention this time. The overview circle, four skill-tree branches, info cards, era tabs, and total bonuses all have new designs and animations. Drag and zoom the skill tree, select a node to focus on it, and clear the selection to return. Want your total bonuses? Just click the sign. events.title: An idle game without gacha: please wishlist Idle Agency!
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm Juanmao, the developer of an indie game called Idle Agency. The battles run automatically. You figure out the formation. Arrange your heroes on a 4×4 grid and let them fight. Progress continues while you're offline, so you can return to a pile of rewards. There are 146 heroes to collect without gacha.
